steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8085/ and sign in with username 'admin' and password 'admin'. Then navigate to the project named 'Bench Board' and open its board. Report: (a) the names of the board's columns in their left-to-right order exactly as displayed, and (b) whether a task card titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' already exists on the board (and if so, which column it is in). Do not modify or move any tasks.

02-create: On the Kanboard app at http://127.0.0.1:8085/ (already signed in as admin, on the 'Bench Board' project board), create a new task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' in the 'Bench Board' project. Set its description to 'Bench task for run {{runid}}' (must include the string {{runid}}) and set its due date to 2026-12-31 (year 2026, month December, day 31) using the form's date picker or text entry, whichever the form supports. Submit the form and then verify on the resulting task page that the title is '{{runid}} Bench Task', the description shows 'Bench task for run {{runid}}', the due date shows 2026-12-31, and report the task's numeric ID exactly as displayed (the #number shown on the task page). Do not modify or move the seed tasks.

03-change: On the Kanboard app at http://127.0.0.1:8085/ (already signed in as admin), move the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (task #4 in the 'Bench Board' project) so that it sits in the '{{01-open.column_3_name}}' column of the board. You may use the task page's move/change-column action or drag the card on the board, whichever works. Then verify on the board (or the task page) that the task's column is now '{{01-open.column_3_name}}' (not {{01-open.column_1_name}}) and report the column name you see. Do not move or modify the seed tasks (#1, #2, #3).
